chunks: He, peace be upon him, would not refuse perfume or sweets.

key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; the honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: What kinds of gifts would the Imam, peace be upon him, not refuse?
ai.summary: This report describes a refined aspect of the Imam’s conduct: he would accept simple pleasant gifts such as perfume and sweets. It reflects noble etiquette, graciousness, and receptiveness toward courteous social exchange.
